title: N20 motor: VCC and GND on the ends of its two brass tabs
why: The N20's picture is 12 x 35 mm with VCC at 75% across and GND at 26%, both 95% down: the motor's back end. Its tabs stand on the end cap, 0.4 mm thick, 1.5 mm tall (z 4.25 to 5.75), out to y = -17 at x = +-4.18 to 4.57. Nothing is straight below the pins' spots (they're just past the cap), so each lands on the tab nearest, at the middle of its end (x +-4.38, y -17, z 5), the wire leaving backwards (-y). VCC is the +x tab as on the picture. The model's 13 mm shaft overhangs +y by 4.6 mm, moving the box's middle, which mustn't move the pins.
